fever: Give fluids, provide rest, check temperature every 4 hours.
snakebite: Keep the patient calm, do NOT cut or suck the wound, rush to hospital.
burns: Keep under cool running water for 20 minutes, do not apply toothpaste.
fracture: Immobilize the limb, avoid movement, seek medical help.
diarrhea: Give ORS after every loose motion, prevent dehydration.
